name: AFID: AITEX Fabric Image Database
description: Public textile fabric surface defect detection benchmark comprising 245 high-resolution textile images (4096x256 resolution) across seven distinct fabric types. Created by the Spanish Textile Industry Research Association (AITEX) and Universitat Politècnica de València, containing 140 defect-free images (20 per fabric) and 105 defective images spanning twelve typical textile manufacturing flaws with binary pixel-level ground truth masks.

provenance.collection_method: High-resolution linear camera system capturing 4096-pixel wide web fabric swatches moving continuously through a controlled textile inspection backlighting rig.
provenance.curation_notes: Encompasses 12 defect classes: broken ends, broken picks, weft curling, fuzzyballs, cut selvage, creases, warp balls, knots, contamination, neps, and weft cracks.
